title: Recent advances in magnetic nanocatalysts for synthesis of imidazo[1,2-a]pyridine frameworks
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,107-143
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA08924G, Review Article
Open Access

Mohamed Abu Shuheil, G. Padma Priya, Amaal Mohammed Ali, Y. Sasikumar, Ahmed Aldulaimi, Renu Sharma, Abhayveer Singh, Radwan Ali, Mosstafa Kazemi
Magnetic nanocatalysts (MNCs) represent sustainable platforms for synthesizing imidazo[1,2-a]pyridine derivatives, key nitrogen-fused heterocycles with wide applications in medicinal chemistry, materials science, and agrochemistry.
